title: Measure shipping time in March
prompt: For every order that was placed in March and has been shipped, return id and days: the number of whole days from the date it was ordered to the date it was shipped. An order that has not been shipped has no shipped_at and must not appear. Sort by id.
hints: Two things are needed from the dates: the month of one, and the difference between two.
Subtracting timestamps gives an interval. Subtracting dates gives a number of days.
CAST(shipped_at AS date) - CAST(ordered_at AS date) AS days ... WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ordered_at) = 3 AND shipped_at IS NOT NULL

wrongAnswers.misconception: Subtracts the timestamps, which gives an interval instead of a number of days.
Includes orders that were never shipped.

feedback: Check that days is a plain number, and that every row has one.
